title: Victrola records and first impressions of Duke and Fletcher
summary: He recalls a grand-aunt's Victrola and thinks he heard Ellington, McKinney's and perhaps Fletcher Henderson, with Stanley Dance sorting out the dates.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening
